description: Starts connecting the person's AWS account, Azure subscription or Google Cloud project to a project, with no key or password. Answers one line for the person to paste into their cloud's own browser shell (shellName, shellUrl, command), how long it works, what it grants, and the line that undoes it. Show the person the command exactly. CodeGene connects by itself once the line has run; check_cloud_account says when. Owners and admins of the project only.

bundles.description: What CodeGene may do in the account beyond signing in. Leave it out to connect with sign-in only; services added later ask for what they need.

id.description: A permission bundle id from list_cloud_permissions.

values.description: The names the bundle needs, by parameter id, such as { zone: ['acme.com'] }.

cloud.description: Which cloud: aws, azure or google_cloud.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: connect_cloud_account
title: Connect a cloud account
